note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸科目，老師的模板沒有這一列；不列入期中考範圍。
note.en: An extension account added by the site; the teacher's template has no such line and it is outside the mid-term scope.

definition.zh-TW: 已經發生、還沒付出去的利息。它是流動負債；間接法的「其他負債增加」不可以把它算進去，否則會和利息支出列重複。
definition.en: Interest that has accrued but has not yet been paid. A current liability; it must be kept out of the increase in other liabilities line in the indirect method, or it would double count the interest paid line.
